draftText: Rockstar hasn't promised you 60 fps in GTA 6. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson reportedly told YouTuber Davy Jones consoles run it at 30 for now. On 60, he said he'd have to consult the technical team. Digital Foundry suspects crowds, weather and traffic AI overload the console CPU. Even your PS5 Pro might not save you. That's Rockstar's habit. GTA 5 waited for PS5 to hit 60, and Red Dead 2 still hasn't officially. I'd expect 30 at launch. Our GTA documentary covers which launch promises hold, so what has Rockstar actually promised you?
